lines.text: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven, and the priests could not enter the house of the LORD.
When the Israelites saw the fire and the glory, they bowed with faces to the ground and gave thanks.
Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep, and the Levites stood with instruments that King Saul had made.
Solomon consecrated the middle of the courtyard for offerings, and Israel kept the feast for seven days.
On the twenty-third day of the third month, Solomon sent the people home joyful and glad of heart.
